findings.summary: The built-in data model exploration tool receives a description prefix telling the agent to call it after itself, creating a circular/contradictory instruction.
findings.failure_scenario: An EnrichMCP app is created with title 'My API'. The explore_my_api_data_model tool's final description becomes: 'This is a retriever for the My API server. Use it after calling explore_my_api_data_model. IMPORTANT: Call this tool FIRST...' The LLM agent sees conflicting ordering instructions -- the prefix says to use this tool only after calling explore_my_api_data_model, while the body says to call this tool first. The agent may delay calling the data-model tool (looking for a nonexistent prerequisite), loop, or ignore the FIRST instruction, degrading the quality of subsequent tool interactions.
